findings.title: Positive fixture claims verified_hash with stale artifact digest
findings.evidence: artifact.sha256 and provenance_records[0].payload_digest contained 897962cf88598a4fb553b8c2b7c2d2af4d9d3d49cc0a1c1195776cf9b43eb8a7 for scripts/validate-contracts.sh, but the current file digest was d82e30736d3fff747446ba3d63de059c7664d33161a5523a0179b68f7bb9093f.
findings.required_fix: Update the artifact.sha256 and payload_digest in the positive fixture to match the current scripts/validate-contracts.sh digest, or mark integrity as not_assessed.

findings.title: Pinned ajv-cli@5.0.0 dependency chain carries documented high-severity audit findings
findings.evidence: npm audit reports two high severity vulnerabilities via fast-json-patch <3.1.1 in the ajv-cli@5.0.0 dependency chain. The project documents this as residual risk and warns against auto-fixing because the validator strategy is pinned.
findings.required_fix: Replace ajv-cli with a local validator strategy that does not carry the fast-json-patch audit finding.

p2.evidence: All stale validate-contracts.sh digests were replaced with d82e30736d3fff747446ba3d63de059c7664d33161a5523a0179b68f7bb9093f. Contract manifest, local DSSE envelope, and release verification digest were regenerated.

p3.evidence: Validation moved from ajv-cli@5.0.0 to pinned local ajv@8.20.0 through scripts/validate-json-schema.mjs. package.json and package-lock.json pin ajv to exact 8.20.0, not a semver range. npm audit --json reports zero vulnerabilities.
